runners_data.name: Town Queen
runners_data.note: Front-running style with proven class edge but faces tactical disadvantage if pace becomes pedestrian

runners_data.name: Distant Shore
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from 283-day break with perfect winning record and superior finishing kick

runners_data.name: Karvala
runners_data.note: Confirmed closer who benefits from modest early pace despite disappointing recent Windsor effort

runners_data.name: Perfect Ruler
runners_data.note: Prominent tracker ideally positioned behind pace-setter but lacks finishing punch of hold-up rivals

runners_data.name: Porth Eilian
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with moderate form but tactical advantage if race develops into sprint finish

races.paceDynamic: Town Queen and Perfect Ruler will contest the early lead with Town Queen likely to prevail given her proven front-running ability and superior class edge. With only two genuine pace angles in a small field, Town Queen should dictate comfortable fractions through the middle stages without pressure. The modest early pace will compress the field turning for home, bringing the hold-up horses Distant Shore, Karvala and Porth Eilian into play with strong finishing kicks. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up brigade who can unleash late runs against the modest gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Town Queen sets uncontested fractions and the pace becomes pedestrian
scenarios.body: The compressed field allows Distant Shore and Karvala to unleash devastating late runs that the modest early pace cannot repel. Class and finishing kick prove decisive over tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner kicks clear
scenarios.trigger: If Town Queen quickens turning for home before the closers can organise
scenarios.body: Her class advantage and tactical position allow her to build an unassailable lead in the straight. The hold-up horses respond too late to bridge the gap.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Perfect Ruler travels perfectly behind Town Queen and times her challenge ideally
scenarios.body: She gets first run on the leaders while avoiding traffic, proving too strong for both the tiring pace-setter and the wide-finishing hold-up horses. Perfect positioning trumps pure pace dynamics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise outsider emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Porth Eilian finds significant improvement from her recent Windsor effort
scenarios.body: Her hold-up style benefits from the modest pace while her rivals underperform, allowing her superior turn of foot to prevail. Form reversal catches the market off-guard.

watchPoints.text: Town Queen must quicken decisively turning for home before Distant Shore's superior class and fresh legs take effect
Perfect Ruler's ability to secure ideal tracking position behind Town Queen without getting trapped on rails
Distant Shore shaking off 283-day rustiness early in contest to deliver her customary strong finish
Karvala finding the significant improvement needed from disappointing Windsor fifth to justify hold-up tactics
Overall pace development through first four furlongs determining whether front-runners or closers gain tactical edge

races.paceDynamic: Flight Plan will lead uncontested early, setting a comfortable gallop with no other dedicated front runners in the field. The prominent brigade of Sea Force, Blue Rc, Mirsky, City Of Poets, Esherann, A War Eagle and Bellarchi will create serious congestion behind the leader from 3f out as they all jostle for position. This will become a war of attrition in the final 2f as the pace quickens and the hold-up horses try to find racing room through the pack. The sustainable early gallop followed by intense late pressure favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently without getting caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners can secure clear runs turning for home
scenarios.body: Blue Rc and Sea Force have the class and position to capitalize when the pace lifts, avoiding the worst of the traffic that will engulf the hold-up horses. Their forward position allows them to respond immediately when Flight Plan comes under pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses find clear passages through the prominent traffic
scenarios.body: Al Mubhir and Apiarist have the highest ratings in the field and can produce telling late kicks if they avoid trouble in running. The Kevin Ryan pair know how to win these competitive handicaps when getting the right setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Flight Plan Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the leader can maintain his gallop while the pack behind fights it out
scenarios.body: Flight Plan's uncontested lead gives him every chance to see out the trip, especially with the prominent horses taking lumps out of each other behind. Sam James can dictate terms and kick again when the challengers arrive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites get trapped behind the wall of prominent runners
scenarios.body: A War Eagle and Bellarchi could emerge from the ruck with clear runs while higher-rated rivals are stuck without racing room. The pace collapse would suit their finishing kicks perfectly.

watchPoints.text: Flight Plan's jumping from the gates - if slow away the race dynamics completely change with no other natural leader

races.paceDynamic: Shipshape is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms uncontested from the gates. With four hold-up horses behind him (Analogical, Ashdown Forest, Marbuzet, Scottish Dancer), Shipshape can set his own fractions without pressure through the early stages of this 1m6f contest. The lack of pace pressure allows Shipshape to kick clear when ready, while the hold-up brigade will need him to stop or face a difficult task from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers, as the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground if Shipshape maintains his advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Shipshape Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Shipshape gets an easy lead and maintains his kick
scenarios.body: Connor Beasley can dictate comfortable fractions and have enough left to resist late challengers on this stamina-testing trip. The hold-up horses face an impossible task trying to reel in an unchallenged leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and Shipshape ties up
scenarios.body: Analogical's superior class (OR 79) and recent good form allows him to time his challenge perfectly in the final furlong. Marbuzet's stamina and good going record also comes into play.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Shipshape Stops Dramatically
scenarios.trigger: If Shipshape's 17-day break tells and he hits the wall
scenarios.body: The field comes back to him rapidly in the final two furlongs, allowing the best stayer to prevail. Scottish Dancer's long absence becomes irrelevant as class tells.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Disaster
scenarios.trigger: If Shipshape goes too slowly and everyone gets there together
scenarios.body: A messy sprint finish develops where track position and luck in running matter most. The apprentice claim on Scottish Dancer could prove decisive in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Shipshape's early fractions - if he gets an uncontested lead the race could be over before it begins
Scottish Dancer showing any early life despite the 1065-day absence as the apprentice claim is significant

Marbuzet handling the step back up in distance after 203 days off the track
The overall tempo through the middle stages as a crawling pace would transform this contest completely

races.paceDynamic: Kosometsuke will likely lead from the outset with his prominent style and recent winning form, though Kats Bob, Sugar Baby, Emperor Caradoc and Mr Dreamseller all show prominent tendencies that could challenge early. With only one confirmed front runner against multiple prominent horses, the pace should develop into a solid gallop without being punishing. The hold-up contingent of Aberama Gold, Mister Sox, Rock Opera and Khabib will sit off this steady tempo. This setup clearly favours the hold-up horses who can benefit from the solid pace and finish strongly in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses engage early and sustain a solid pace throughout
scenarios.body: The tempo will be perfect for the closers to pick up the pieces, with Aberama Gold and Mister Sox having the class to capitalize. Both have shown their best form when allowed to come from off the pace at this trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Kosometsuke Gets Easy Lead
scenarios.trigger: If the other prominent horses fail to press Kosometsuke early
scenarios.body: He can dictate a slower tempo and kick clear in the final furlong as he did when winning last time out. His recent 6f success and good course record make him dangerous if uncontested.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too strong and the prominent horses tie up
scenarios.body: The race will turn into a sprint finish where the freshest horse wins regardless of running style. Rock Opera's higher topspeed figure could prove decisive in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses can both press the pace and sustain their effort
scenarios.body: Kats Bob or Mr Dreamseller could dominate if they get the fractions right and their recent form holds up. This requires perfect jockey judgment and a career-best performance.

races.paceDynamic: Tatterstall is the only confirmed front-runner in this field and will likely get an uncontested lead, setting a comfortable pace over this sharp 5f at Thirsk. With most rivals preferring prominent or hold-up tactics, there's no obvious pressure source to challenge Tatterstall early, allowing for measured fractions. The lack of genuine pace pressure creates a tempo that will suit horses with tactical speed who can position handily and finish strongly. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with proven finishing kicks over pure hold-up horses who may find themselves too far back on the quick Thirsk 5f circuit.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Tatterstall gets soft sectionals and maintains stamina reserves for the finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the front-runner to dictate terms and prove hard to peg back in the final furlong. Prominent runners tracking closely also benefit from the honest but manageable gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the handy runners can sit just off Tatterstall and produce superior finishing speed
scenarios.body: The tactical pace allows prominent horses to conserve energy while staying close enough to pounce when the front-runner tires. This scenario particularly suits those with proven acceleration.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the modest early pace creates a bunched field entering the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed creates a sprint finish from the 2f pole where horses with strong finishing kicks can sweep up from midfield positions. Quality hold-up performers can overcome their positioning disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Tatterstall goes too slow early and multiple horses challenge simultaneously in the straight
scenarios.body: The suddenly increased tempo in the final 2f catches out both the front-runner and those dependent on steady pace. Horses with natural speed and fitness benefit most.

races.paceDynamic: Pension Pot stands out as the sole confirmed front runner in this nine-runner field, likely to dictate terms from the rail without serious early pressure. Law Supreme, Lightning Galaxy, Thats My Boy Luke and Front Gunner all show prominent tendencies but may settle just behind rather than challenge for the lead. The hold-up brigade of Sunny Orange, Rising Force, Kiss Me My Love and Off Spin will need the pace to develop sufficiently for their finishing kicks. This tactical scenario strongly favours the prominent runners who can track Pension Pot's likely steady gallop and strike in the final two furlongs before the closers can unleash.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Pension Pot sets steady fractions and the prominent horses track him perfectly
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Law Supreme, Lightning Galaxy or Thats My Boy Luke to position ideally and strike decisively approaching the final furlong. The hold-up horses find insufficient pace development to mount their typical late charges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too hard trying to collar Pension Pot mid-race
scenarios.body: This creates the pace collapse scenario that perfectly suits Sunny Orange's proven ability to finish strongly, with Rising Force also dangerous if the gallop develops. Kiss Me My Love could benefit from her recent proximity to pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Pension Pot gets his own way on the lead with perfect fractions
scenarios.body: The David Barron-trained four-year-old proves too tough from the front, maintaining his gallop when the field comes to him. His recent second at Thirsk on similar ground provides the blueprint for success.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If all the prominent runners hesitate behind Pension Pot creating crawling fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Off Spin and Kiss Me My Love can utilise their tactical speed from unpromising positions. This scenario requires significant tactical errors from multiple jockeys.
